title: My AI project in 7 phases: a practical simulation kit for generative AI
description:
One conversation with an AI assistant takes a workplace initiative from first idea to dissemination, in seven phases. Each phase has a technique, a prompt to fill in, an iteration and a checklist. A teaching resource of the Ciência e Letras generative AI courses.

Teaching resource of the course Getting Started with ChatGPT and AI · GenAI for IT Professionals (Ciência e Letras).

Live tool: https://ciencia-letras.github.io/kit-projeto-ia/

Code under the MIT licence; content under CC BY 4.0. Any institution may use, adapt and share it, as long as it cites the tool.

For training. Use a real or invented project, but never real personal data.
